alex: heads-up — seeing intermittent batch hang / p99 spikes on Mistral 8x7B when sliding-window mode is enabled and clients send variable max_pos values. repro is flaky but reproduced on canary.

risha: can you paste the stack/logs? is it kernel selection or kv cache churn?

alex: snippet from runtime logs: 
```
[2026-03-12T14:22:03Z] batcher: forming batch id=0x7c size=8 seqlens=[16,1024,48,64,1024,32,16,512]
[2026-03-12T14:22:03Z] kernel_selector: chosen=sliding_window_attn_v2 kernel_id=0x2e heur=seqbound
[2026-03-12T14:22:03Z] kv_cache: attach ptr=0x23f ttl=inf max_pos=2048
[2026-03-12T14:22:03Z] runtime: request 0xabc stalled waiting for kv merge for 7.2s
```

sam: interesting — two long sequences (1024) plus others cause the batcher to pick a sliding-window kernel optimized for long contig. but we still see a stall waiting for KV merge. Could be cache fragmentation: different requests have overlapping pos ranges which triggers expensive rebase/merge.

maria: also check rope_scale / max_position_embeddings mismatch from model config vs client. If a client sends a wrapped pos (max_pos < used pos) we see weird pointer shifts. Did you see any "pos_wrap" warnings?

alex: yes saw a few: `pos_wrap_detected request=0xabc client_max_pos=1024 model_mpe=2048`

risha: that explains the kernel choice flip. Kernel selector uses sequence length distribution and assumes contiguous POS space. If some requests present wrapped positions we may attempt a kernel optimized for contig memory layout but then the KV rebase path runs and does pointer moves that are O(K) and block the batch.

sam: quick mitigation: prefer splitting batches by max_pos_buckets and seq_len buckets so we don't mix wrapped+nonwrapped sequences. Also add a short cooldown on heavy KV splice operations so they don't stall other inflight lanes.

alex: tried a patch locally: prefer_single_seq_for_heavy_kv = true and split_by_pos_bucket = true — reduced p99 from 430ms -> 120ms on the canary with same QPS. will push results.

ci-bot: deploy started: runtime/patch/split-by-pos-bucket -> canary-3 on us-west2-gpu (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

maria: long-term fix: make kernel selector aware of kv_rebase_cost and pos_wrap probability. i.e. score = latency_est + kv_rebase_penalty. that avoids choosing sliding-window kernel when majority of batch will trigger merges.

risha: we should also emit a small per-batch histogram telemetry: num_wrapped, avg_rebase_ops, median_seq_len, chosen_kernel. ops teams can alert when rebase_ops > X.

sam: logging idea: add a short trace at batch formation to capture per-request `client_max_pos` and `kv_base_pos`. Example: 
```
batch_metadata: {
  seqlens: [16,1024,48,...],
  client_max_pos: [2048,1024,2048,...],
  kv_base_pos: [0,1024,0,...]
}
```
Then kernel_selector can access and avoid bad combos.

alex: another observation — quantized kernels have slightly different memory layout, and when we fallback between int8 and fp16 kernels mid-batch we saw pointer alignment issues. Not sure if related.

maria: ugh. we should ensure kernel compatibility check includes kv-layout-compat and rope-scale compatibility. if incompatible -> force serial execution for that request or use copy-to-contig buffer which is expensive but safe.

risha: short-term checklist before wide rollout: 
- add batcher split by pos bucket (done in canary)
- expose `num_wrapped` telemetry in per-route dashboard
- add kernel_selector penalty for expected_kv_rebase_cost
- add unit test that mixes wrapped/nonwrapped requests and asserts no blocking > 1s

sam: tests to add in perf harness: random mix of seqlens + client_max_pos mismatch; measure p50/p95/p99 and KV merge ops/sec. Also ensure fallback path doesn't OOM when copying contig buffers.

alex: pushing a small profiling artifact: perf flame for the long case shows 70% time in `kv_merge::do_splice` and GPU idle waiting for CPU merge. attaching snippet: 
```
CPU: kv_merge::do_splice 70%
GPU: kernel waiting_for_kv_merge 62%
```

maria: follow-up work items (tracking):
- (eng-runtime) kernel_selector: add kv_penalty scoring.
- (eng-runtime) batcher: pos_bucket split + prefer_single_seq_for_heavy_kv flag.
- (eng-ml) model metadata: ensure Mistral configs include `mpe` and `rope_scale` explicitly in catalog.
- (devex) add example client that sets client_max_pos correctly and docs around sliding-window caveats.

risha: sounds good. alex — can you open a short PR with metrics + tests and link the canary perf numbers? we'll merge once CI passes.

alex: will do. attaching the canary comparison: p99 430->120, rebase_ops/s 85->8, error_rate unchanged. PR incoming in ~1h. :thumbsup:
